title: Triangle appears above Russian naval vessels off Kamchatka
place_text: Pacific Ocean off Kamchatka, eastern Russia

tellings.quote: we had a a surveillance asset uh in the ocean off the uh I believe was Kamchchatka but the the eastern seabboard of Russia in the in the Pacific
While they are observing the Russian vessels, a large black triangle materializes or decloaks or something.
tellings.difference: Told secondhand by Corbell, who says the triangle materialized or decloaked and gives no place (Kamchatka) or year.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of a large black triangle appearing above Russian naval vessels while they were being watched, from Matthew Brown and the Immaculate Constellation material.

as_told.title: Black triangle decloaks above Russian vessels

plain: A US surveillance asset watching Russian naval vessels in the Pacific off Kamchatka, in Russia's far east, saw a large black triangle appear right above the ships, according to a former Defense Department official named Matthew Brown, who tells Michels it was in a briefing he calls Immaculate Constellation; the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell retells it from Brown, saying the triangle "materializes or decloaks or something", and gives no place or year. Immaculate Constellation is also the name of an unsigned report entered into the record of a House Oversight hearing on 13 November 2024; it calls itself the public version of a Defense Department employee's report, Brown later said he wrote it, and a Defense Department spokesperson said the department has no record of a program by that name. One case in the report has "a large equilateral-triangle UAP" (UAP is the official term for UFOs) appear "directly over the ships" collecting "at night in a specific area of the Pacific Ocean", and puts the ships' presence down to "foreign pre-positioning of advanced collection assets". The report calls the vessels foreign and the place a specific area of the Pacific, so the reading that this is the Kamchatka case with Russian ships comes from Brown's and Corbell's accounts. If the story is true, an unknown craft was watching the same ships US intelligence was watching.

discussion.by: Immaculate Constellation report (anonymous, entered into the House Oversight hearing record, 13 November 2024)
discussion.text: An unsigned report that Michael Shellenberger delivered to Congress and Rep. Nancy Mace entered into the record of the House Oversight hearing of 13 November 2024 as a document from the Pentagon; it calls itself the public version of a Defense Department employee's report, cleared for release by the State Department; Matthew Brown, a former Defense Department official, later said he wrote it; and a Defense Department spokesperson said the department has no record of a program by that name. The report's case "INDOPACOM Intelligence Vessels Positioned to Collect on Reproduction Vehicle" has "a large equilateral-triangle UAP" appear "directly over the ships", a grouping of vessels collecting "at night in a specific area of the Pacific Ocean", whose presence it puts down to "foreign pre-positioning of advanced collection assets". That this case is the one off Kamchatka with Russian vessels comes from Matthew Brown's and Jeremy Corbell's accounts of the briefing; the report gives the place as a specific area of the Pacific and the vessels as foreign.
